Context: For employees covered under National Pension Scheme

| From 1-4-2019 | 28% of Basic Pay plus DA employee's contribution - 10% employer's contribution -14% + 4% for gratuity |  
- (a) These pension contributions would be in addition to the leave salary contributions for the period of foreign service, in respect of both NPS employees and the employees under Old Defined Benefit Pension Scheme.
